problems.text: The audit lives inside kmctl, so nobody can audit a folder of docs without installing kmctl and following its layout.
kmctl carries the audit's CLI group, extra and dependencies though the operator now wants kmctl optional.
The skills, agents, docs, README and decision records describe the audit as `kmctl audit` and the repository as one package.

goals.text: kmaudit is a library of its own that installs and runs without kmctl.
kmctl no longer holds or advertises the audit.

outcomes.change: kmaudit installs and runs with kmctl absent
outcomes.checked_by: a test that builds the kmaudit wheel, installs it into a new venv without kmctl and runs `kmaudit claims todo` on a fixture bundle; and a test that no module under packages/kmaudit imports kmctl

outcomes.change: The root gates run kmaudit's tests next to kmctl's
outcomes.checked_by: kmaudit is a workspace source in the root dev group, so a plain `uv sync` installs it; `uv run pytest` at the root collects the tests under packages/kmaudit/tests and tests/ in one run

outcomes.change: kmctl has no audit group or extra, and the agents' guard hook calls kmaudit
outcomes.checked_by: a test that `kmctl audit --help` exits 2 as an unknown command and that kmctl's metadata names no audit extra; `tests/test_apm_package.py` pins the agents' hook command as `kmaudit guard --allow GROUP`, and the guard lets through `kmaudit GROUP` commands only

outcomes.change: Docs, the README and a decision record name kmaudit
outcomes.checked_by: `git grep "kmctl audit"` finds nothing outside .loop/, .okf/log.md, .okf/prototypes/, .okf/decisions/ (accepted records keep their history notes; superseded ones keep their text), and the Action's own audit-mode refusal in `action.yml` and `docs/how-to/install-the-plugin-and-the-ci-action.md`; okf validate --strict passes; the root README names both packages and links kmaudit's own README
